## Accurate brand facts
- Consumer line: “النكهة في اللُّب / Flavor in the kernel.”
- HUBB uses an Arabic-first identity with hand-crafted calligraphic energy and a modern Saudi Sadu rhythm.
- Product and nutritional claims on this pre-launch site must be verified against final laboratory, SFDA and production data before publication.
